news.title: Deni Avdija scores 28 points in the Trail Blazers' 118-110 win over the Nuggets
news.text: — Deni Avdija scored nine of his 28 points in the fourth quarter and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Denver Nuggets 118-110 on Monday night, extending their road winning streak to begin the season.

news.title: Avdija scores 24 and Lillard has 22 as Portland rolls over Utah 112-90
news.text: — Deni Avdija scored 24 points, Damian Lillard added 22, and the Portland Trail Blazers rebounded from their first loss of the season by blowing past the Utah Jazz 112-90 on Saturday.

news.title: Source: Fever hires Blazers' Sheri Sam as assistant GM
news.text: Sheri Sam, who was the scouting manager for the Trail Blazers, has been hired as assistant general manager of the WNBA's Fever, a source told ESPN.

news.title: Ja Morant out at least 4 weeks with hamstring strain suffered against Grizzlies
news.text: Trail Blazers guard Ja Morant sustained a left hamstring strain in his first game against the Grizzlies, his former team, and will be out for at least four weeks.
